content/faq.ts.קריטרה היא מרקטפלייס ישראלי לאשראי עסקי: Critera is a marketplace for business financing and investment, with deals starting at $1 million. Submit a request anonymously, and Critera's AI prepares a credit package or investor presentation. Your request is then matched with relevant lenders and investors, who can review the opportunity and submit offers.
content/faq.ts.לחברות, ליזמים ולקבלנים שמגייסים מימון א: Critera brings together businesses, developers, and contractors seeking financing or investment, lenders and investors looking for opportunities, and brokers and financial advisors managing deals for their clients. It supports financing for real estate projects, acquisitions, working capital, and business growth.
content/faq.ts.בקריטרה יש ארבעה סוגי עסקאות: גיוס ומתן: Critera offers four marketplaces: Business Lending, Loan Portfolio Trading, Syndication & Co-Lending, and Equity, Partnerships & M&A. Each focuses on a different type of financing or investment transaction.
content/faq.ts.מה המשמעות של תקופת ההרצה?: What does the launch phase mean?
content/faq.ts.הפלטפורמה פעילה וההרשמה פתוחה. בתקופת הה: Critera is live and accepting registrations and deal submissions. We're expanding our network of lenders and investors while continuing to improve the platform based on user feedback. Early participants can benefit from personal support and special launch terms.
content/faq.ts.מה ההבדל בין קריטרה לבין מכרזי הלוואות א: How is Critera different from a loan comparison site?
content/faq.ts.מכרז הלוואות משווה מחירים על בקשה בנקודת: Critera goes beyond comparing loan offers. It prepares a professional credit package or investor presentation, connects deals with relevant lenders and investors while keeping requests anonymous, and supports the process through closing. The platform also brings together brokers, advisors, and other professionals and supports investment, syndication, and co-lending.
content/faq.ts.מה הפלטפורמה מציעה ל־Family Offices?: What does Critera offer family offices?
content/faq.ts.גישה לעסקאות חוב והון המותאמות לתחומי הה: Family offices can explore debt and equity opportunities matched to their investment criteria, review professionally prepared deal materials, and manage transactions through closing and ongoing monitoring. Qualified investors can also collaborate on joint offers. Registration requires confirmation of qualified investor status.
content/faq.ts.מגישים בקשה, ומנוע AI מנתח את המידע ומכי: Submit your request, and Critera's AI analyzes the information and prepares a credit package or investor presentation ready for a credit or investment committee. Your request is shared anonymously with relevant lenders and investors, and all offers arrive in one place. You compare the terms, choose who to move forward with, and complete the documents and checks needed to close.
content/faq.ts.תוך כמה זמן מקבלים הצעות?: How soon will I receive offers?
content/faq.ts.לאחר הכנת תיק האשראי או מצגת המשקיעים וה: Once your credit package or investor presentation is ready and your request has been shared with relevant lenders and investors, timing depends on how complete your information is, the type of deal, and each institution's review process. From request to closing, the full process typically takes two to six weeks, depending on the size and complexity of the deal.
content/faq.ts.אפשר לקבל דרך קריטרה גם הצעות השקעה?: Can I receive investment offers through Critera?
content/faq.ts.כן. הבקשה יכולה להיות מוצגת גם למשקיעים: Yes. Your request can also be shared with qualified investors, family offices, and strategic partners, so you may receive financing offers, investment offers, or a mix of both. That way you can weigh debt and equity side by side and choose the structure that fits your company best.
content/faq.ts.אפשר לגייס דרך קריטרה השלמת הון עצמי (מז: Can I raise mezzanine financing through Critera?
content/faq.ts.כן. יזמים, קבלנים וחברות יכולים להגיש בק: Yes. Developers, contractors, and companies can request mezzanine financing to close an equity gap, short-term bridge financing, or construction financing from banks or non-bank lenders. Your request is shared with institutions that specialize in that type of financing, and their offers arrive in one place for easy comparison.
content/faq.ts.לחברות מכל תחום: תעשייה, טכנולוגיה, מסחר: Companies in any sector, including manufacturing, technology, trade, services, and real estate. You can raise working capital, equipment and production line financing, tender financing, growth and acquisition financing, or equity investment, starting at $1 million.
content/faq.ts.כמה עולה לגייס מימון או השקעה דרך קריטרה: How much does it cost to raise financing or investment through Critera?
content/faq.ts.הגשת הבקשה היא ללא עלות. החברה המגייסת מ: Submitting a request is free. The company raising capital pays a service fee of 0.8% plus VAT, and only when the deal successfully closes. During the launch phase, a 40% discount on the service fee is available for a limited time.
content/faq.ts.מי רואה את פרטי החברה והעסקה?: Who can see my company and deal details?
content/faq.ts.גופי המימון והמשקיעים המתאימים רואים מיד: Relevant lenders and investors see the information they need to review your request, while details that identify your company and the deal stay confidential. Offers are shown anonymously as well. Identifying details are shared only between the parties moving forward together, and remain confidential from everyone else on the marketplace.
content/faq.ts.האם הגשת בקשה מחייבת לקבל הצעת מימון או: Am I obligated to accept an offer if I submit a request?
content/faq.ts.הגשת הבקשה מאפשרת לכם לבחון הצעות ולנהל: No. Submitting a request lets you review offers and negotiate terms. You decide whether to accept an offer, who to move forward with, or whether to stop the process altogether.
content/faq.ts.האם אפשר לקבל מימון בתנאים טובים יותר?: Can I get better financing terms?
content/faq.ts.קבלת הצעות מכמה גופי מימון מאפשרת להשוות: Receiving offers from several lenders lets you compare rates, costs, and terms and choose the offer that works best for you. Each lender sets its terms based on the deal and its own criteria. Critera does not guarantee a specific rate or any savings on financing costs.
content/faq.ts.אפשר להגיש בקשה להלוואה בערבות המדינה או: Can I apply for a government-backed loan or grant?
content/faq.ts.כן. בפלטפורמה פועלים יועצי מימון שמתמחים: Yes. Financial advisors who specialize in government-backed loans and grants work on the platform. They guide your application through the right program, and the entire process is managed through Critera.
content/faq.ts.מה הפלטפורמה מציעה לגופי מימון ולמשקיעים: What does Critera offer lenders and investors?
content/faq.ts.עסקאות המותאמות לקריטריונים שלכם, ובהם ת: Deals matched to your criteria, including sector, deal size, and financing ratios. Every deal arrives after AI analysis and risk assessment, with a credit package or investor presentation in a consistent format, prepared for credit or investment committees. That way you can focus on the deals that matter and move forward with the ones that fit.
content/faq.ts.כמה עולה השימוש לגופי מימון ולמשקיעים?: How much does Critera cost lenders and investors?
content/faq.ts.השימוש בפלטפורמה הוא ללא תשלום לגופי המי: Access to the platform is free for lenders and investors, subject to a service agreement. You receive deals that have been screened and analyzed by AI, with a credit package or investor presentation prepared for credit or investment committees.
content/faq.ts.מי מקבל את החלטת האשראי או ההשקעה?: Who makes the credit or investment decision?
content/faq.ts.ההחלטה מתקבלת אצל הגוף המממן או המשקיע,: The lender or investor makes the decision, following its own approval process. Critera's AI gathers and analyzes the information, assesses risk, and suggests a deal structure to support the review.
content/faq.ts.האם כמה גופים יכולים לממן עסקה יחד?: Can several lenders finance a deal together?
content/faq.ts.כן. כשעסקה דורשת מימון בהיקף גדול, כמה ג: Yes. When a deal calls for large-scale financing, several lenders can join through syndication or co-lending. They review the same credit package, and each funds a portion of the transaction as agreed among them, under the block exemption for joint lending arrangements and subject to its terms.
content/faq.ts.המימון מגיע מבנקים, מקרנות, מגופים מוסדי: Financing comes from banks, credit funds, institutional lenders, family offices, and qualified investors on the platform. Each institution reviews the deal and decides independently whether to provide financing and on what terms. Unlike retail lending platforms, Critera takes no money from the general public and holds no deposit-like liabilities.
content/faq.ts.איך קריטרה עובדת עם ברוקרים ויועצי מימון: How does Critera work with brokers and financial advisors?
content/faq.ts.קריטרה היא התשתית לצמיחה של ברוקרים ויוע: Critera is built to help brokers and financial advisors grow. They guide their clients and manage the deal from start to finish, while Critera provides the tools to prepare a credit package or investor presentation, access to lenders and investors, and a single place to compare offers. Clients remain associated with the broker or advisor, as set out in the agreement. Client management is discreet, and there are no costs for brokers or advisors, subject to a service agreement.
content/faq.ts.מה תפקידו של מנוע ה־AI בתהליך?: What role does AI play in the process?
content/faq.ts.המנוע מרכז את הנתונים, מאמת אותם מול מאג: Critera's AI compiles the data, checks it against public records, analyzes the deal, assesses risks, predicts asset prices, and prepares a credit package or investor presentation for credit or investment committees. You can review the file, make corrections, and add details before submitting. The lender or investor decides whether to make an offer and on what terms, and you choose who to move forward with.
content/faq.ts.איך נשמרת סודיות העסקה?: How do you keep deals confidential?
content/faq.ts.הבקשות וההצעות מוצגות ללא פרטים מזהים של: Requests and offers are shown without details that identify the parties or the deal. Even when details are shared between the parties moving forward together, they remain confidential from other marketplace participants. Due diligence takes place in a secure data room, and the service agreement includes confidentiality and non-circumvention terms (NDA).
